To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

green leadership can be enacted through the collective green IT initiatives of business networks, and this is contingent upon the attainment of green leadership, which is a process that is characterized by a series of interrelated and interdependent stages, namely, (1) establishing a shared vision, (2) building a sense of urgency, and (3) developing a green IT strategy.

the process of attaining green leadership consists of four stages: (1) establishing the legitimacy of green IT initiatives, (2) building the capacity of green IT initiatives through the creation of an organizational culture that is supportive of green IT initiatives; (3) building an inter organizational business network that is supportive of collective green IT initiatives; and (4) enacting green leadership by leveraging the resources and capabilities of the network to facilitate the implementation of collective green IT projects.
Green Leadership is a collective leadership phenomenon that emerges from a process of inter organizational collaboration and coordination.
